translation.name: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau
translation.englishName: Kilivila: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau Bible

content: Yesu iwini kaikesi toligalega
Igau makateki Luvapela pakala. Yesu inikoli la tuta bogwa leima bisilavi valu watanawa e bilokaia Tamala. Bogwa iyebwaili sala ovalu watanawa, e iyebwaili goli kala kalitutilela la momova iwokuva.
Diabolo bogwa isaili onanola Yudasa
Isikariota Saimoni latula, kidamwa bikasali matauna. Ikamkwamsi,
e Yesu inikoli kidamwa Tamala bogwa isaiki matauna karaiwaga komwaidona e tuvaila inikoli leima metoya baisa Yaubada e ikikaimilavau baisa Yaubada.
Mapaila Yesu itomalaula okabokamkwam, ivilili kala kwama, e ikau talubulabu igigi olopola.
E oluvi iligabu sopi okailuya ivitouula biwini kaikesi toligalega, e bitalubulabu makwayasina deli miyana leigigi.
E imakaia Saimoni Pita, mitaga Pita iluki matauna, kawala, “Tomoya, ki, yoku bukuwini kaikegu?”
Yesu ivitakauloki matauna, kawala, “Avaka auvagi gala kunikoli baisa tuta, mitaga igau bukukwateta.”
Pita iluki matauna, kawala, “Gala goli kwaitala tuta bukuwini kaikegu.” Yesu ivitakauloki matauna, kawala, “Kidamwa gala bawinaim, gala bukubani kam vilavila baisa yeigu.”
Saimoni Pita iluki matauna, kawala, “Tomoya, gala kaikegu wala, mitaga yamagu deli dabagu goli!”
Yesu iluki matauna, kawala, “Availa bogwa ikakaya, bogwa imigileu tomwaidona, e ibodi matauna gala bikakayavau mesinaku kaikela wala.
E yokomi komwaidomi kumigileusi, mesinaku wala taitala.”
Paila inikoli availa bikasali matauna, mapaila ikaibiga, kawala, “Yokomi komwaidomi kumigileusi, mesinaku wala taitala.”
E bogwa iwini kaikesi, isikam kala kwama, isili tuvaila; e iluki matausina, kawala, “Ki, lokukwatetasi avaka lavagi baisa yokomi?
Kudokaigusi, ‘Tovituloki’ kaina ‘Tomoya’, e kukwamokwitasi; paila yeigu makawala goli.
Mapaila kidamwa yeigu mi Tomoya kaina mi Tovituloki lawini kaikemi, ibodaimi bukuwinaisi kaikesi semia taitala taitala.
Paila bogwa asakaimi kabogigisa kidamwa bukuvagaisi makawala bogwa lavigakaimi.
Biga mokwita alukwaimi, towotetila gala bikalisau kala tokwaraiwaga; kaina touwata gala bikalisau kala towitala.
Kidamwa kunikolaisi baisa, bogwa bukumwasawasi kidamwa kuvagaisi makwaina.
“Gala lalilivala paila komwaidomi; anikoli availa bogwa goli lanagi; mitaga ibodi Buki Pilabumaboma kala ginigini makwaina gala bisala, ‘Matauna kakamkwam kamataiyu bogwa leivapupoiyaigu.’
Mitaga wa tuta matutona alukwaimi igau gala bikaloubusi, kidamwa nasigavila bikaloubusi bukudubumaisi kidamwa yeigu matauna.
Biga mokwita alukwaimi, availa biboda matauna awitali, e matauna bibodaigu; e availa bibodaigu matauna biboda agu towitala.”
Yesu ivitububoti kala tokwasesila
Bogwa ikaibiga makawala, Yesu ikaikai nanola, e ikabau, kawala, “Biga mokwita alukwaimi, taitala yokomi bikasalaigu.”
Toligalega igisamapusi sola baisa sola, e ininayuwasi paila availa goli ililivali.
Taitala la toligalega, Yesu tombwailila, isividuli Yesu.
Mapaila Saimoni Pita imitikipoki matauna, e ikaibiga, kawala, “Kukwatupoi paila availa goli eililivali.”
Matauna isividuli Yesu, e ikalakova ikatupoi, kawala, “Tomoya, availa matauna?”
Yesu ivitakaula, kawala, “Ka, kawotala bavidagu basaiki availa; e matauwena goli.” Mapaila bogwa ividagu makawona isaiki Yudasa, Saimoni Isikariota latula.
Tutala bogwa ikau, Setani isikaila matauna. Yesu iluki matauna, kawala, “Avaka goli mwada bukuvagi nani kuvagi.”
E gala availa wa kabokamkwam inikoli avaka uula ilivala makawala baisa matauna.
Paila Yudasa toyamata mani kauyala e mimilisi idokaisi kidamwa Yesu eiluki matauna, “Kugimoli avaka ibodaidasi paila paka”; kaina eiluki kidamwa bisaiki avaka baisa tonamakava.
Mapaila bogwa ikau makawona, nanakwa isunapula; e bogwa eidudubila.
Kwaitala karaiwaga kwaivau
Mapaila Yudasa bogwa leisunapula, Yesu ikaibiga, kawala, “Baisa tuta yeigu Latula Tomota babani agu yakaula, e Yaubada bibani kala yakaula metoya baisa yeigu.
E kidamwa Yaubada bibani kala yakaula metoya baisa yeigu,
Yaubada tuvaila biyakawolaigu metoya baisa titoulela, e nanakwa biyakawolaigu.
Gugwadi,
igau tuta pikekita asikailimi. Bukunevaigusi, e makawala laluki mina Yudia
makawala baisa tuta alukwaimi, ‘Ambaisa bam, gala igagabila bukuwaisi.’
Karaiwaga kwaivau asakaimi, kidamwa bukuyebulikaimi baisa taitala taitala; makawala bogwa layebwailimi, makawala goli yokomi bukuyebulikaimi baisa taitala taitala.
Kidamwa kuyebulikaimi baisa taitala taitala, metoya baisa tomota komwaidosi binikolaisi kidamwa yokomi ulo toligalega.”
Yesu iluki Pita igau biyakali
Saimoni Pita ikatupoi matauna, kawala, “Tomoya, am bukula?” Yesu ivitakaula, kawala, “Ambaisa bam, gala igagabila bukubokulaigu baisa tuta; mitaga tuta oluvi bukubokulaigu.”
Pita iluki matauna, kawala, “Tomoya, avaka paila gala igagabila babokulaim baisa tuta? Batugwalaigu okaliga paila yoku.”
Yesu ivitakaula, kawala, “Bukutugwalaim okaliga paila yeigu ke? Biga mokwita alukwaim, rekorekwa gala bisilasola, mitaga bukusivatolu bukuyakalaigu.
